sources.quote: registrants may not solicit or use testimonials, and CMTO guidance asks them to turn off social media features that invite them
sources.publisher: College of Massage Therapists of Ontario
sources.title: Advertising
sources.evidence: RMT advertisements cannot include testimonials from existing or former clients, and their friends or relatives. RMTs should take all reasonable steps to disable social media functions that allow for testimonials, and/or remove the content, or disassociate it from pages related to their practice. These requirements are outlined in the Massage Therapy Act, 1991 and the General and Professional Misconduct Regulations.

sources.quote: Implied consent runs six months from an inquiry and two years from a purchase
sources.title: From Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL) Guidance on Implied Consent | CRTC
sources.evidence: You may have implied consent if the recipient has made a purchase or lease of goods, services, land or interest in land within the two-year period immediately before the day on which the message was sent, or has made an inquiry or application within the six month period immediately before the message was sent.

sources.quote: Registered massage therapy is not on the Excise Tax Act list of exempt health services, so unlike physiotherapy or chiropractic care it is taxable
sources.title: Application of the GST/HST to the Practice of Acupuncture - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: Massage therapy is not an acupuncture service for GST/HST purposes and a supply of massage therapy is subject to tax (unless another exemption from the GST/HST applies). A supply of massage therapy services rendered to an individual by a Registered Massage Therapist would not be included in the exempt services if the massage therapy services were supplied separately.

sources.quote: a therapist past the small supplier threshold, roughly CAD 30,000 in taxable revenue over four quarters, charges GST or HST
sources.title: When to register for and start charging the GST/HST - Canada.ca
sources.evidence: You are no longer a small supplier and you must register for the GST/HST if your total revenues from taxable supplies are over $30,000 in a single calendar quarter or over the last four consecutive calendar quarters.

sources.quote: which keeps the clinic out of the body rub category that bylaws such as Toronto's Chapter 545 license separately
sources.title: Body Rub Parlour – City of Toronto
sources.evidence: Body rub parlours are any place where non-medical or non-therapeutic massaging services are provided by someone other than registered massage therapists, or other licensed or registered holistic practitioners. Every person who owns or operates a body-rub parlour must obtain a licence under Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 545; the City has 25 licensed body rub parlours and is no longer accepting new applications.

sources.quote: CMTO even runs a public Look Before You Book campaign telling Ontarians to check the register first
sources.publisher: College of Massage Therapists of Ontario
sources.title: Look Before You Book
sources.evidence: CMTO's Look Before You Book campaign is a longstanding initiative that aims to raise awareness of how CMTO protects the public, using digital channels to increase the number of Ontarians who use the public register (Find an RMT) to look up reliable info about Registered Massage Therapists and verify whether the person they are visiting is registered and qualified to practise.

sources.quote: works under the Health Professions and Occupations Act, in force since April 1, 2026
sources.publisher: College of Complementary Health Professionals of British Columbia
sources.title: Massage Therapists - CCHPBC
sources.evidence: Massage therapists are currently regulated by the College of Complementary Health Professionals of BC under the Health Professions and Occupations Act. The HPOA replaced the Health Professions Act (HPA) on April 1, 2026; the regulation under the HPOA authorizes registrants in this profession to use the titles massage therapist and massage practitioner.
